title: A Free Tool Gives Your AI Agent Eyes Across Six Major Platforms
summary: Agent-Reach, a new open-source command-line tool, lets AI agents read and search across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu — all from one interface, with no API fees.

title: Open-Source AI Can Now Operate a Full Desktop — Mac, Windows, or Linux
summary: A project called CUA (Computer-Use Agents) is trending on GitHub.

title: A Free Script Strips the Clutter That Slows Down Windows 11
summary: Win11Debloat is a lightweight PowerShell script that removes pre-installed apps, disables telemetry, and cleans up default settings on Windows 10 and 11.

title: A Deep Free Guide to Running Your Own Software Without Big Tech
summary: The Self-Hosting Guide on GitHub covers everything from running your own AI models and cloud storage to setting up home networking and automation with tools like Home Assistant and WireGuard.

title: Kronos: An AI Foundation Model Built Specifically for Financial Market Language
summary: Kronos is a new open-source foundation model designed from the ground up to understand the language of financial markets — earnings calls, trading signals, price commentary, and economic reports.

title: A New Open-Source Tool Can Clone Any Voice — In Any Language
summary: VoxCPM2, a new open-source AI model from OpenBMB, generates speech in multiple languages and can clone a person's voice from a short sample, without needing the usual step-by-step text breakdown other speech tools rely on.

title: A Free Tool Lets Businesses Run Their Own WhatsApp Bot
summary: OpenWA is a free, self-hosted gateway that lets a business connect its own systems to WhatsApp — for order updates, support replies, or reminders — without paying for WhatsApp's official business API.

title: A Privacy Tool Strips Pre-Installed Bloatware From Android Phones
summary: Universal Android Debloater is a free tool that removes manufacturer and carrier apps from non-rooted Android phones to improve privacy, security, and battery life.

title: An Open-Source Tool Logs Everything Your Tesla Does
summary: TeslaMate is a self-hosted logger that tracks a Tesla's trips, charging sessions, and battery health over time, giving owners a private dashboard instead of relying on Tesla's own app and data.

title: A Self-Hosted Alternative to Spotify Connect Is Trending Again
summary: Music Assistant is a free media-library manager that connects your own music files and streaming accounts to a wide range of smart speakers, acting as a private alternative to relying on a single streaming app's ecosystem.

title: A Lightweight Vector Database Built for AI Search
summary: Alibaba released zvec, a free, lightweight vector database designed to run in-process rather than as a separate server.

title: A New Networking Stack Replaces IP Addresses With Cryptographic Keys
summary: Iroh is an open-source, modular networking library in Rust built around connecting to a cryptographic key instead of an IP address, so a connection can survive a device changing networks or its address breaking.

title: An Open-Source Project Turns Your AI Coding Assistant Into a Video Production Studio
summary: OpenMontage, a new open-source toolkit, gives AI coding agents over 500 video-editing skills and 52 specialized tools spanning 12 production pipelines — covering everything from scripting to final cut.

title: A Free, Open-Source Alternative to Figma Keeps Climbing GitHub's Trending List
summary: Penpot is an open-source design tool that lets designers and developers work directly on the same files — no proprietary format, no per-seat licensing.

title: Google Researchers Release a Foundation Model Built Just for Forecasting
summary: TimesFM is a pretrained model from Google Research designed specifically to forecast time-series data — sales figures, web traffic, demand curves — without retraining it on your own data first.

title: An Open-Source Communications Platform Pitches Itself for 'Mission-Critical' Teams
summary: Rocket.

title: An Open-Source AI Agent Can Now Click, Type, and Navigate Your Whole Desktop
summary: UI-TARS-desktop, from ByteDance, is an open-source AI agent stack that can see your screen and operate your computer directly — opening apps, filling forms, navigating menus — instead of just answering questions in a chat window.

title: A New Framework Tries to Standardize How AI Coding Agents Learn 'Skills'
summary: Superpowers is an open-source framework and methodology for packaging reusable capabilities — 'skills' — that AI coding agents like Claude Code can load on demand, rather than re-explaining how to do a task every time.

title: An MCP Server Promises Near-Instant Code Search Across 158 Languages
summary: Codebase Memory MCP indexes an entire codebase into a persistent knowledge graph, then answers questions about it in milliseconds rather than re-reading files every time.

title: A New Open AI Model, GLM-5, Aims to Replace 'Vibe Coding' With Real Engineering
summary: Z.

title: A New AI Model Generates Matching Video and Audio Together
summary: Lightricks released LTX-2, an open-source AI model that creates video and matching audio from a single prompt, plus tools to fine-tune it for specific styles.

title: An All-in-One Platform for AI Coding Agents Is Trending on GitHub
summary: Kilo Code bills itself as an all-in-one platform for building and running AI coding agents, bundling several tools developers currently juggle separately into one workflow.

title: A New Tool Turns Messy Documents Into Searchable Knowledge Maps
summary: Hyper-Extract is a free tool that uses AI to convert unstructured text, like contracts, reports, or research papers, into structured graphs and timelines with a single command.

title: The Team Behind Astro Is Building a 'Sandbox' Framework for AI Agents
summary: Flue, from the makers of the popular Astro web framework, is a new open-source framework for running AI agents inside sandboxes — isolated environments where an agent's actions can't affect the rest of your system.

title: GitHub Built an AI That Lets Any Employee Query Company Data in Plain English
summary: GitHub described how it built Qubot, an internal assistant that lets any employee ask questions about company data in plain English and get an answer back — instead of waiting on a data team to write the database query.

title: A Fully Open AI Model Pitches 'Sovereign AI' for Anyone Who Wants Control
summary: A new foundation model called Apertus has been released with fully open weights, aimed at "sovereign AI" — countries and organisations running capable models they own and control rather than renting access from a handful of US firms.

title: GitHub Copilot Switches to Pay-As-You-Go Pricing
summary: GitHub is moving Copilot, its widely used AI coding assistant, to usage-based billing: your activity now draws down "GitHub AI Credits" instead of a flat monthly fee.

title: A Free Dashboard Tries to Replace Doomscrolling With One Calm Screen
summary: WorldMonitor, a free open-source project, pulls global news, geopolitical events, and infrastructure status into a single real-time dashboard and uses AI to summarise and flag what actually matters.

title: An Open Tool Gives AI Assistants a Long-Term Memory
summary: Cognee is an open-source tool that gives AI assistants memory across sessions, so they remember earlier context instead of starting from scratch every conversation.

title: A Tool That Squeezes 60–95% of the Cost Out of AI Requests
summary: Headroom sits between your application and a large language model and compresses what gets sent in — tool outputs, logs, files, and retrieved document chunks — reporting 60 to 95 percent fewer tokens while keeping the same answers.

title: A Modern Rewrite of SQLite, the Database Hiding in Your Phone
summary: Turso is an in-process SQL database compatible with SQLite — it runs inside your app rather than as a separate server — but it's being rebuilt from scratch in Rust to add features SQLite has long lacked, such as better handling of simultaneous writes and built-in syncing.

title: A Small AI Model Punches Far Above Its Size
summary: Researchers released VibeThinker, an open model with just 3 billion parameters that, on reasoning benchmarks, reportedly matches or beats Anthropic's far larger Opus 4.

title: Valve's Steam Machine Goes on Sale
summary: Valve started selling the Steam Machine, a small living-room computer that plays PC games on your TV the way a console does.

title: Microsoft Locks In 20 Years of Power for a Texas Data Center
summary: Chevron signed a 20-year deal to supply electricity to a new Microsoft data center in West Texas.

title: An Open-Source Studio for AI Voices
summary: Voicebox is a free, open-source tool for cloning voices, dictating, and generating speech from text.

title: A Free Tool for Editing PDFs on Any Device
summary: Stirling-PDF, now the most popular PDF project on GitHub, lets you merge, split, sign, and convert PDFs in your browser without uploading them to someone else's server.

title: Running a 70-Billion-Parameter Model on a 4GB GPU
summary: AirLLM is a library that runs very large language models — up to 70 billion parameters — on a single graphics card with as little as 4GB of memory.

title: How GitHub Made Issues Feel Instant
summary: GitHub's engineering team rebuilt how its Issues pages load, using client-side caching, smart prefetching, and service workers so that moving between issues feels immediate instead of waiting on the network each time.
